surface: The LUMINAiRY complete Patron Saint, MAiVEN and Trailblazer profiles

reverseBrief.humanQuestion: Why is each person or cultural Patron in the LUMINAiRY, what did she contribute, which AI concepts does that illuminate, how do people encounter them, and what changes at work today?
reverseBrief.promisedPayoff: A complete, credible contribution-to-concept-to-human-use chain with a distinct practical lesson and verified routes to read, watch, listen to or follow the woman's work where applicable.
reverseBrief.centralMentalModel: Patron Saints make practices memorable; MAiVENs explain how computing and AI got here; Trailblazers show present-day AI work in motion. Each profile connects its source to concepts, human interaction and workplace consequence.
reverseBrief.dailyLifeConnection: Readers can recognise where each concept appears in an ordinary AI interaction and apply its exercise to a workplace task, decision, source check or handoff.
reverseBrief.surfaceJob: A searchable, expandable reference archive and personal circle builder for all three LUMINAiRY wings.
reverseBrief.desiredReaderFeeling: I understand why she is here, what is distinct about her role, and exactly what I can try next.
